pending_interview.category: System design (general) — scalability patterns; designing common systems like a URL shortener, rate limiter, chat system, notification system
pending_interview.question: You are designing a notification delivery system for a large consumer app with 50 million users. The system needs to send notifications across multiple channels — push notifications, email, and SMS — with support for different priority levels (for example, a security alert should always go through immediately, while a weekly digest can be batched). Walk me through how you would design this system: the high-level architecture, how you would handle scale, how you would ensure high-priority messages are not delayed by high-volume low-priority traffic, and what happens when a downstream channel (like an email provider) is slow or temporarily unavailable.
